acceptanceCriteria: each listed form is flagged with its line, with a fixture per form
a justified annotation suppresses the finding with the reason retained
with a run receipt the observed single value is proposed; without one, no proposal
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1191. Flag assertions that accept any of several distinct values for a status/enum/outcome field: toContain on a literal array, || inside expect, oneOf matchers, regex alternation over status codes, and 'X or Y' wording in behaviour-contract expected values. Cite the line; propose the single value when a passing run receipt records it; honour an explicit justification annotation.
title: GH #1191: test-validity EITHER-OR-OUTCOME - assertions accepting several distinct status/enum outcomes
